grc:verb:μνημονεύω.gloss: call to mind, remember, think of

grc:adj:μοῦνος.gloss: Epic and Ionic form of μόνος (mónos)

grc:noun:κλῆρος.gloss: a beetle destructive in bee-hives, Clerus apiarius

grc:verb:οἶσθα.gloss: second-person singular present active indicative of οἶδᾰ (oîdă)

grc:verb:ἐφῆκεν.gloss: third-person singular aorist active indicative of ἐφίημι (ephíēmi) with movable nu

grc:noun:ἰχθύσι.gloss: dative plural of ῐ̓χθῡ́ς (ĭkhthū́s) and ῐ̓χθῦς (ĭkhthûs)

grc:noun:ἰχθύσιν.gloss: dative plural of ῐ̓χθῡ́ς (ĭkhthū́s) and ῐ̓χθῦς (ĭkhthûs) with movable nu

grc:name:Λαομέδων.gloss: a male given name, equivalent to English Laomedon

grc:name:Ἀλκμήνη.gloss: a female given name, equivalent to English Alcmene

grc:other:Ν.gloss: The letter nu (νῦ), the 13th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.

grc:other:ν.gloss: Lower-case nu (νῦ), the 13th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. It represented the alveolar nasal /n/. It is preceded by μ and followed by ξ.

grc:verb:ἐσμέν.gloss: first-person plural present active indicative of εἰμί (eimí): we are

grc:verb:ἤκουσεν.gloss: third-person singular aorist active indicative of ἀκούω (akoúō) with movable nu

grc:noun:βλάβος.gloss: βλάβ-ος, gen. eos , contr. ous , τό

grc:verb:εἴην.gloss: first-person singular present active optative of εἰμί (eimí)

grc:verb:ἀτιμάζω.gloss: hold in no honour, esteem lightly

grc:art:τόν.gloss: masculine accusative singular of ὁ (ho, “the”) and ὀ (o, Cretan and Lesbian form of ὁ (ho, “the”))

grc:pron:τόν.gloss: masculine accusative singular of ὁ (ho, demonstrative pronoun) and ὅ (hó, relative pronoun)

grc:verb:λέγουσιν.gloss: third-person plural present active indicative of λέγω (légō) with movable nu

grc:verb:λέγουσι.gloss: third-person plural present active indicative of λέγω (légō)

grc:verb:παῦσαι.gloss: second-person singular aorist middle imperative of παύω (paúō)

grc:verb:νικώμενος.gloss: present mediopassive participle contracted of νῑκάω (nīkáō)

grc:verb:ἄνωγας.gloss: second-person singular perfect active indicative of ἄνωγα (ánōga)

grc:verb:ἀγγέλλομαι.gloss: first-person singular present mediopassive indicative of ἀγγέλλω (angéllō)

grc:verb:ἔτλης.gloss: second-person singular aorist active indicative of ἔτλην (étlēn)

grc:verb:ἐπιψαύω.gloss: touch on the surface, touch lightly

grc:verb:θέλεις.gloss: second-person singular present active indicative of θέλω (thélō)

grc:verb:ἕξομεν.gloss: first-person plural future active indicative of ἔχω (ékhō)

grc:verb:φερέτω.gloss: third-person singular present active imperative of φέρω (phérō)

grc:verb:φησί.gloss: third-person singular present active indicative of φημῐ́ (phēmĭ́)

grc:verb:φησίν.gloss: third-person singular present active indicative of φημῐ́ (phēmĭ́) with movable nu

grc:verb:μελλόντων.gloss: third-person plural present active imperative of μέλλω (méllō)
